text_blocks.snippet: Adverse reactions to the COVID-19 vaccine can range from common, mild side effects to rare, severe reactions. Common side effects include fatigue, headache, muscle aches, joint pain, chills, fever, and nausea. These typically resolve within a few days. More serious reactions, like anaphylaxis, are extremely rare and characterized by symptoms like difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or throat, and rapid heartbeat. These require immediate medical attention.
